name: Google Changhua County Data Center
notes: Google's official location page says it has invested over US$1.6B in construction, expansion, outfitting, and continuous upgrading of its Changhua data center since 2011; contemporary reporting says the Changhua facility opened in December 2013 and expansion was already underway.

name: National Chung Cheng University Computer Center Green Data Center Retrofit
developer: National Chung Cheng University; Stark Technology; Delta Electronics
notes: Delta case study describes the complete renovation of National Chung Cheng University's 28-year-old computer center data center in Chiayi, consolidating two rooms into a 205 sq m green data center and reducing power use by about 35%.

name: NXComp Chiayi Puzi TSC Site
notes: NXComp lists a Chiayi Puzi TSC site in Puzi City, Chiayi County with about 59,600 sq m of land and references modular data center, DCIM, colocation, and data center services. No independent confirmation or capacity found.

name: CHT Hsinchu Zhubei IDC
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's IDC service page lists Hsinchu Zhubei IDC among its professional data centers; third-party listings place it at No. 136 Guangming 5 Street, Zhubei City, Hsinchu County, with 9,074 sq ft and a reported 3 MW capacity.

name: NCHC Hsinchu High-Performance Computing Center
notes: NCHC's official pages list Hsinchu headquarters at No. 7 R&D 6th Rd., Hsinchu City and describe HPC services including Taiwania-series systems and Forerunner 1; DC Hub reports the Hsinchu facility as operational with 3 MW.

name: NCSIST Yilan Data Center Power Distribution Project
developer: National Chung-Shan Institute of Science & Technology; Hong-Tai Electric Industrial Co.
notes: Hong-Tai's customer performance map lists a National Chung-Shan Institute of Science & Technology Yilan Data Center Power Distribution Project. No capacity, commissioning date, or independent confirmation found.

name: Foxconn-NVIDIA Taiwan AI Data Center / AI Factory, Kaohsiung phase
developer: Hon Hai Technology Group (Foxconn), NVIDIA, Taiwan ecosystem partners
notes: Computex reporting quotes Foxconn chairman Young Liu saying the NVIDIA AI data center would be built in phases in Kaohsiung and other Taiwan regions, targeting 100 MW overall and starting with an initial 20 MW phase.

name: CHT Kaohsiung Zhongshan IDC
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's official page lists Kaohsiung Zhongshan IDC as a four-floor 727+ sq m data center with 100 racks and 2 kW primary/redundant standard rack power provisioning; implied rack provision is about 0.2 MW before overhead.

name: CHT Kaohsiung Qixian IDC
notes: Chunghwa Telecom's official page lists Kaohsiung Qixian IDC as a 957+ sq m, one-floor data center with 63 racks and 2 kW standard rack primary power provisioning; implied rack provision is about 0.126 MW before overhead.

name: MediaTek Tongluo AI R&D Data Center
notes: Taipei Times reports MediaTek completed first-phase computing power buildout at its data center in Tongluo Township, Miaoli County, providing 15 MW for R&D; DigiTimes describes it as a new R&D data center at Tongluo Science Park using NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD.
